title: CALM Kubernetes Extension Standard
description: CALM 1.2 overlay Standard for the Kubernetes pack. Extends node-type with the pack's type ids. Architecture shape remains https://calm.finos.org/release/1.2/meta/calm.json. Hosts write this $id into architecture $schema when the pack is first used, even before the URI is published on calm.finos.org.
$comment: Proposed until published under calm.finos.org. Load from extensions/standards/ on the filesystem.
